name: ngx-fiber-js
description: A simple Fiber JS plugin with ad/edit/delete canvas functionality with text and images
author: Gohil Jaykumar

scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && cd dist && npm publish && cd .. && npm run release:git
scripts.release:check: test "$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)" = main || { echo "Release from the main branch"; exit 1; }; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo "Commit or stash your changes before releasing"; exit 1; }; npm owner ls "$npm_package_name" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^$(npm whoami 2>/dev/null) " || { echo "Log in to npm (npm login) as an owner of $npm_package_name first"; exit 1; }
scripts.release:git: git add -A && git commit -m "release: v$npm_package_version" && git tag -a "v$npm_package_version" -m "release: v$npm_package_version" && if git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push origin HEAD:main --follow-tags; else echo "No git remote: release commit and tag kept locally"; fi
